traps.title: Use fetchWrapper for HTTP requests
traps.context: When making network requests or 网络请求, use the project fetchWrapper.
traps.mistake: Calling fetch or axios directly bypasses retry and timeout handling.
traps.fix: Use fetchWrapper and follow the HTTP request convention.

traps.title: Use session helpers for authentication
traps.context: When implementing 认证 or login flows, use the shared session helper.
traps.mistake: Reading cookies directly duplicates auth behavior.
traps.fix: Call the session helper and centralize redirects.

traps.title: Run SQLite migrations through schema.ts
traps.context: When changing the 数据库 schema, add an idempotent migration.
traps.mistake: Editing only queries leaves existing databases stale.
traps.fix: Increment SCHEMA_VERSION and backfill old rows.

traps.title: Read configuration from env adapter
traps.context: When reading 配置, use the env adapter.
traps.mistake: Scattering process.env reads makes tests brittle.
traps.fix: Read through the config/env module and inject values in tests.

traps.title: Invalidate Redis cache after writes
traps.context: When mutating cached records, clear 缓存 keys.
traps.mistake: Updating SQLite without clearing Redis returns stale results.
traps.fix: Invalidate cache keys in the same write path.

traps.title: CLI flags must not become query text
traps.context: When parsing command arguments, consume flag values.
traps.mistake: Treating --mode hybrid as positionals appends hybrid to the search query.
traps.fix: Return opts and positionals from parseArgs.

traps.title: StickS3 projects need the correct ESP-IDF target and 8MB flash size
traps.context: When rebuilding a StickS3 project from ESP-IDF hello_world, configure target esp32p4 and 8MB flash.
traps.mistake: Leaving the default target or flash size creates builds that flash or boot incorrectly on StickS3.
traps.fix: Set the ESP-IDF target to esp32p4 and configure the board for 8MB flash before adding application logic.

traps.title: Do not assume StickS3 screen and buttons work directly through M5Unified
traps.context: When wiring StickS3 screen or button support, verify M5Unified compatibility first.
traps.mistake: Assuming M5Unified abstracts the StickS3 LCD and buttons can hide board-specific setup gaps.
traps.fix: Check the board support path and fall back to explicit LCD/button initialization when M5Unified is not enough.

traps.title: Native ST7789 screen init must power the PMIC over I2C first
traps.context: When a native SPI/ST7789 StickS3 screen stays black, check PMIC power rails before tuning SPI.
traps.mistake: Debugging SPI timing while the display power or backlight was never enabled.
traps.fix: Initialize the PMIC over I2C and enable display power before sending ST7789 commands.

traps.title: Keep Doubao ASR on the Mac agent side, not inside ESP32 firmware
traps.context: When adding voice typing to StickS3, the ESP32 should stream audio and the Mac agent should call Doubao ASR.
traps.mistake: Trying to put Doubao ASR credentials and HTTP transcription directly into ESP32 firmware.
traps.fix: Keep ASR on the Mac proxy/agent side and let firmware send audio frames to that local service.

traps.title: VOICE_SERVER_URI cannot use localhost or 127.0.0.1 from StickS3
traps.context: When StickS3 connects to a Mac WebSocket voice server, localhost points to the board, not the Mac.
traps.mistake: Setting VOICE_SERVER_URI to ws://127.0.0.1:8765 makes the board connect to itself.
traps.fix: Use the Mac LAN IP address in VOICE_SERVER_URI, for example ws://192.168.x.y:8765/...

traps.title: ES8311 probe address 0x18 is a 7-bit address, not an 8-bit address
traps.context: When probing ES8311 over I2C and seeing address 0x18, distinguish 7-bit and 8-bit address notation.
traps.mistake: Treating 0x18 as the wrong shifted 8-bit address causes codec init confusion.
traps.fix: Use 0x18 as the 7-bit ES8311 I2C address expected by ESP-IDF drivers.

traps.title: StickS3 I2S microphone DIN is GPIO16, not GPIO14
traps.context: When recorded WAV samples are all zero on StickS3, check the I2S microphone DIN pin.
traps.mistake: Using GPIO14 for I2S DIN writes the speaker DOUT pin instead of reading the microphone.
traps.fix: Set I2S DIN to GPIO16 for microphone input and keep GPIO14 for speaker DOUT.

traps.title: Do not lower VOICE_MIC_GAIN just because peak reaches 32768
traps.context: When StickS3 voice capture reports peak=32768, inspect quality and ASR timing before changing gain.
traps.mistake: Immediately lowering gain and reflashing firmware based only on a saturated peak value.
traps.fix: Check quality metrics and asr_timing first; only tune VOICE_MIC_GAIN when the end-to-end signal is actually clipped or slow.
